content.short: A decentralized protocol for sustainable open-source funding through recurring per-second streams and splitting.
content.description:
Drips Network is a decentralized protocol for sustainable open-source funding. It enables recurring, per-second settlement, allowing for continuous and programmable cash flow instead of one-time grants. Through dependency splitting, a percentage of received funds is automatically forwarded to a project's dependencies, creating a 'trickle-down' funding effect.

Integrating with GitHub, maintainers can claim projects and manage distributions easily. Users can also create Drip Lists to fund multiple projects with a single stream. Drips Network offers a non-custodial experience that ensures user sovereignty while building a resilient and interconnected Web3 funding infrastructure.
content.meta: Sustainable open-source funding on Ethereum: recurring per-second streams, dependency splitting, and GitHub integration via Drips Network.
